daily.title: Renewal before worship
daily.note: Taught before Tarāwīḥ: any farḍ or Qurʾān recitation should begin by renewing faith, cleanliness and sincerity.

daily.when: Daily — opens every wird and every holy night
daily.title: Adab al-Ṭarīqa (Naqshbandī)
steps: al-Fātiḥa ×1 — intending the manifestations and protection descending in Makka
Lā ilāha illā-llāh ×10, after the last: Muḥammadun Rasūlu-llāh
Ṣalawāt ×10 (Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli Muḥammadin wa sallim)
al-Ṣalawāt al-Sharīfa (Ṣalli yā Rabbi wa sallim ʿalā jamīʿi l-anbiyāʾi wa l-mursalīn…)
Ihdāʾ to the Prophet ﷺ, the prophets, the four Imāms and the Naqshbandī masters (Shāh Bahāʾuddīn, ʿAbd al-Khāliq al-Ghujduwānī, Shaykh Sharafuddīn, Shaykh ʿAbdallāh, Shaykh Nāẓim)
al-Fātiḥa ×1 — intending what descends in Madīna
daily.note: Transcribed from Mawlana Shaykh Muhammad Adil's sheet for the night of Isrāʾ wa-l-Miʿrāj (images in post #1126).

daily.title: al-Awrād al-Qudsiyya — Ḥizb of Shāh Naqshband
daily.note: Elders of the order agree it serves all needs, wards off calamity, eases hardship, increases nearness, brings insight and healing.

daily.when: Daily, one ḥizb per weekday (Mon→Sun, 8th on Monday)
daily.title: Dalāʾil al-Khayrāt — ḥizb of the day
daily.note: Mawlana Shaykh Nazim: recite the Dalāʾil for all your problems. In Ramaḍān, 1 juzʾ of Dalāʾil between ʿAṣr and Maghrib.

daily.title: al-Ṣalāt al-Kubrā — portion of the day
daily.note: Traditionally recited whole; the seven-day division is for those beginning. Primary purpose: love and sulūk. Seek ijāza from your own shaykh.

daily.when: Once after Fajr (seeker); morning + after Maghrib is the most complete
daily.title: Ḥizb al-Wiqāya — Ibn ʿArabī
steps: After Fajr ×1 — for the seeker on the path
After ʿAṣr ×1, preceded by Sūrat al-Wāqiʿa — provision, relief of poverty
Morning ×1 and after Maghrib ×1 — the most complete method
×3 after two rakʿas of Ṣalāt al-Ḥāja — for needs
×41 in one sitting for weighty matters (may be shared among a group); fast that day and give discreet ṣadaqa

daily.title: Duʿāʾ al-Ḥifẓ (protection)
daily.note: Recommended 7× daily by Mawlana Shaykh Nazim.
daily.notext: The words of this duʿāʾ are not carried in any Kunūz source. Post #154 gives only a video link; no post, book, page scan, document or sohbah in the engine contains the text, so it is not reconstructed here. Recite it from the video or your own printed copy, 7 times.

links.t: Video with the text (YouTube, from post #154)

daily.title: Ḥizb al-Baḥr — with Iʿtiṣām and Ikhtitām
daily.note: Protection from the evil ones and their attacks; pairs with the Ṣalāt al-Mashīshiyya (Ibn Mashīsh's ṣalawāt and his successor's ḥizb go together).

daily.title: al-Ṣalāt al-Mashīshiyya
steps: Allāh Allāh Allāh — each “āh” extended about 12 counts
Q 28:85 and Q 18:10 (end of older copies); some add Q 33:56
daily.note: Truthfulness and sincerity, expansion of the breast, ease, protection inwardly and outwardly, divine assistance.

daily.title: Ḥizb al-Barr (al-Ḥizb al-Kabīr)
daily.note: The Great Ḥizb is recited after Fajr; opens with Āyat al-Istiftāḥ (Q 6:54) — hope for the repentant.

daily.title: One juzʾ of Qurʾān
daily.note: Sohbah of Mawlana Shaykh Mehmet: “A Juz of the Qurʾān must be read daily.” Yā Sīn at the beginning of the day — wants supplied (Mishkāt 2177).
daily.notext: Read from a muṣḥaf. The engine keeps your place: it shows which juzʾ comes next and moves on when you finish.

daily.title: Counting the 99 Names
daily.note: Whoever counts them every day enters Paradise; make duʿāʾ with them. The Greatest Name is sought through worship, given to the one who deserves it, and is for īmān, not dunyā.

daily.title: Friday Ṣalawāt — Kunūz al-Asrār
daily.note: Mawlana Shaykh Nazim's Friday ṣalawāt (Kunūz al-Asrār).
daily.notext: The Friday ṣalawāt of Kunūz al-Asrār are not carried in any Kunūz source. Posts #143 and #151 give a video link; post #152 shares the Kunūz al-Asrār PDF (28.7 MB) on Telegram only, which the engine cannot open. Nothing is reconstructed here: recite from the video or the PDF.

links.t: Video: Friday Ṣalawāt, Arabic & English (YouTube, posts #143, #151)

daily.title: Special litany for spiritual and physical wealth
steps: Lā ilāha illā-llāh ×100, then Muḥammadun Rasūlu-llāh once
Innā li-llāhi wa innā ilayhi rājiʿūn ×100
Lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā bi-llāhi l-ʿaliyyi l-ʿaẓīm ×100
daily.note: From a book page shared on the channel (Mawlana Shaykh Adnan's teachings): an angel is appointed for whoever reads each a hundred times daily; the doors of the Divine Oceans open.

occasions.title: Rajab — daily duties of the month
steps: Prayer of Rajab: 30 rakʿas across the month in twos — each rakʿa Fātiḥa + Ikhlāṣ ×11

occasions.title: Laylat al-Raghāʾib
steps: The Grand Transmitted Duʿāʾ of Grandshaykh ʿAbdallāh (ad-Duʿāʾ al-Maʾthūr)

occasions.title: Isrāʾ wa-l-Miʿrāj
steps: Night: Niyya; Adab al-Ṭarīqa; the Grand Transmitted Duʿāʾ of Grandshaykh; Khatm al-Khwājagān and dhikr; read the Mawlid
Ṣalāt al-Tasābīḥ 4; Ṣalāt al-Shukr 2 with Qunūt
Ṣalāt al-Miʿrāj 2 rakʿas: each Fātiḥa + Ikhlāṣ ×20 (Shaykh Adnan's sheet: Shukr 2 with Ikhlāṣ ×3; Sunnat al-Miʿrāj 2 with Ikhlāṣ ×21)
Shaykh Nāẓim: complete 1000 Ikhlāṣ, 1000 lā ilāha illā-llāh, 1000 ṣalawāt, 1000 istighfār (100 each if 1000 is too much); a qurbān if able

Day of 27th: fast; Ikhlāṣ ×1000; between Ẓuhr and ʿAṣr 4 rakʿas in twos — each: Fātiḥa, Falaq, Nās, Qadr ×3, Ikhlāṣ ×11 — then the duʿāʾ ‘Allāhumma innī asʾaluka bi-mushāhadati asrāri l-muḥibbīn…’ and ask for any need until ʿAṣr

occasions.title: Shaʿbān — month of ṣalawāt
steps: Allāh 5000–10,000 (with the tongue and on the heart)
Recite the Ṣalāt al-Kubrā — Shaʿbān is the month of ṣalawāt

occasions.title: Ramaḍān — Adab and Awrād
steps: Last third of the night after Ṣalāt al-Wuḍūʾ: Niyya (Nawaytu l-arbaʿīn…), Adab al-Ṭarīqa, Marḥaban duʿāʾ (from 15th: al-Widāʿ), Duʿāʾ al-Maʾthūr
Complete the awrād in three windows: last third → sunrise; ʿAṣr → Maghrib; Maghrib → ʿIshāʾ
Between ʿAṣr and Maghrib: 1–3 juzʾ of Qurʾān and 1 juzʾ of Dalāʾil
Before Tarāwīḥ: taʿawwudh, basmala, shahāda ×3, istighfār ×100, Ikhlāṣ ×3, then the fasting niyya on the intention of Grandshaykh and Mawlana

20 rakʿas in 10 sets with the call between each set (Liqāʾu-llāhi yurjā fi-ṣ-ṣiyām…; aṣ-ṣalātu-l-jāmiʿa…; ṣalawāt) and a Name after each: Yā Subḥān, Yā Sulṭān, Yā Raḥmān, Yā Raḥīm, Yā Ḥannān, Yā Mannān, Yā Amān, Yā Dayyān, Yā Fattāḥ, Yā Salām — then Yā Allāh before Witr
Witr 3 with Ikhlāṣ / Falaq / Nās and Qunūt (with the added lines)

Wird after Witr: Subbūḥun quddūs ×2+1; lā ilāha illā-llāh ×100; Allāh ×100; Hū ×33; Ḥaqq ×33; Ḥayy ×33 (each with Ḥasbunā-llāh…); Subḥānim-Allāh Sulṭānim-Allāh ×5; ṣalawāt ×10; Sayyid al-ṣalawāt; ʿIshāʾ awrād; Ṣalawāt al-Mahdī ×3

occasions.title: Eve of 16 Ramaḍān — night of Ṣāḥib al-Zamān
steps: Witr split 2+1; after the two: ṣalawāt and Yā Aḥad
Sūrat al-Aʿlā / al-Kāfirūn / three Quls on the 16th night and Laylat al-Qadr

occasions.title: Laylat al-Qadr — adab of Grandshaykh and Mawlana
steps: Ghusl one hour before Maghrib on their intention
Niyya: nawaytu-l-arbaʿīn, nawaytu-l-ʿuzla, nawaytu-l-khalwa, nawaytu-l-iʿtikāf, nawaytu-s-sulūk, nawaytu-r-riyāḍa…
2 rakʿas sunnat al-ghusl; Adab al-Ṭarīqa; Duʿāʾ al-Maʾthūr
Maghrib and ʿIshāʾ with all awrād; renew fasting niyya; 20 Tarāwīḥ
Ṣalāt al-Tasbīḥ 4, Ṣalāt al-Shukr 2, Witr with Qunūt
100 rakʿas in twos: Ikhlāṣ ×2 in the first, ×1 in the second
Stay awake with Qurʾān and awrād; Ṣalāt al-Najāt, Fajr with awrād, Ishrāq
Next day: two sacrifices for the Umma and the people of Ṭarīqa, meat to the poor

occasions.title: Last night of Ramaḍān and ʿĪd
steps: After Witr, stand toward the qibla: 100 ṣalawāt, gifting the month's worship as Mawlid to the Prophet ﷺ
Pay Zakāt al-Fiṭr before the ʿĪd prayer
Keep the ʿĪd night alive; takbīr, taḥmīd, tahlīl, tasbīḥ through the day

occasions.title: Yawm ʿArafa
steps: Duʿāʾ al-Maʾthūr of Grandshaykh — highly recommended for forgiveness and the gaze upon the reader

occasions.title: Birth of Shāh Naqshband
steps: Recite the Ḥizb Qudsiyya as a gift to his memory

occasions.title: Ṣafar practice
steps: Daily for protection and preservation: Shahāda ×3
Ṣadaqa every day with the intention of removing troubles

occasions.title: Last Wednesday of Ṣafar — adab of Grandshaykh
steps: After sunrise: 2 rakʿas Ṣalāt al-Ḥifẓ, Ikhlāṣ ×3 after Fātiḥa in each; Shaykh Adnan adds istighfār ×15 before Fātiḥa then ×10 at each posture
Āyat al-Kursī ×7 — blow and wipe over the body
Sūrat al-Fīl ×7 with taʿawwudh and basmala each time, blowing over self, family and house
Ihdāʾ to the Prophet ﷺ and the masters (al-Fātiḥa)
Give ṣadaqa before leaving the house
Before ʿAṣr: Ṣalāt Ṣafar, 4 rakʿas in twos — each rakʿa Fātiḥa ×1, al-Kawthar ×17, al-Ikhlāṣ ×5, al-Falaq ×1, al-Nās ×1; then duʿāʾ for safety and the Ihdāʾ
Stay home Wednesday Fajr → Thursday Fajr if possible; no fish or seafood that day
occasions.note: May be continued daily for difficult times.

occasions.title: Mawlid al-Nabī ﷺ
steps: Recite the Mawlid of Grandshaykh ʿAbdallāh al-Fāʾiz (al-Daybaʿī / al-Barzanjī)

occasions.title: ʿUrs of Shaykh ʿAbd al-Qādir al-Jīlānī
steps: Al-Fātiḥa; Ṣalāt al-Kubrā and Qādirī awrād

occasions.title: Passing of Mawlana Shaykh Nazim (7 May 2014)
steps: Ṣalāt al-Khuṣūṣ for Mawlana; his personal duʿāʾ after Khatm al-Khwājagān

occasions.title: Remembrance of Mawlana Shaykh Adnan Kabbani
steps: Fātiḥa or any free offering of Qurʾān and adhkār

occasions.title: ʿUrs of Grandshaykh ʿAbdallāh al-Fāʾiz al-Dāghistānī (30 Sep 1973)
steps: Fātiḥa; his Duʿāʾ al-Maʾthūr and as-Sayyid ad-Duʿāʾ

occasions.title: Laylat al-Barāʾa — night of 15 Shaʿbān
steps: Sūrat Yā Sīn ×3: first for rizq and not needing people; second for long life with strong īmān; third for protection from every affliction for us and the Umma
After each Yā Sīn the duʿāʾ of the night (posted on @MawlanaSultan)
The Grand Transmitted Duʿāʾ of Grandshaykh ʿAbdallāh
100 rakʿas in twos: first rakʿa Fātiḥa + Ikhlāṣ ×2, second Fātiḥa + Ikhlāṣ ×1

occasions.title: Last Friday (Thursday night) of Shaʿbān
steps: Mawlana Shaykh Nāẓim: many tajallīs descend this night — keep it with worship

occasions.title: Muḥarram wazīfa
steps: Added to the daily dhikr: 40 Ṣalawāt Tunjīnā

occasions.title: Entering the Hijrī year
steps: Fast the last day of Dhū al-Ḥijja and the first of Muḥarram (Ibn ʿAbbās: a year's fasting completed)
At the new moon: ghusl and 2 rakʿas sunnat al-ghusl to welcome the year
Duʿāʾ of farewell to the old year ×3 (Allāhumma mā ʿamiltu fī hādhihi s-sana…), then the duʿāʾ of the new year

occasions.title: ʿĀshūrāʾ — 10 Muḥarram
steps: Full ghusl (intending good health); kohl in the eyes; buy provisions for the home; charity to family and the poor
Ikhlāṣ ×1000; istighfār and lā ilāha illā-llāh 100 each; ṣalawāt ×1000
After Adab al-Ṭarīqa: 4 rakʿas Sunnat ʿĀshūrāʾ (between Ẓuhr and ʿAṣr) — each Fātiḥa + Ikhlāṣ ×11
Duʿāʾ of ʿĀshūrāʾ ×7: Subḥāna-llāhi milʾa l-mīzān wa muntahā l-ʿilm…
An hour before Maghrib, face the qibla, finish the Adab and make tawassul with Sayyidinā al-Ḥusayn and the martyrs of Karbalāʾ

occasions.title: Duties of Rabīʿ al-Awwal
steps: Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu mina ẓ-ẓālimīn ×100

occasions.title: 12 Rabīʿ al-Awwal — wazīfa as a gift for the Mawlid
steps: Recite ×11: Yā Allāh, Yā Raḥmān, Yā Ghafūr, Yā Raḥīm, Yā Ḥannān, Yā Mannān, Yā Dayyān, Yā Subḥān (Shaykh Muḥammad Ghawth Gwaliyari: a blissful state the whole year)

teachings.x: A wird is a litany of approach recited at set times, usually given orally by the master; a ḥizb carries a connotation of guardianship, recited when needed. In practice the line blurs: Ḥizb al-Barr is recited after Fajr.
Mulk, malakūt, jabarūt and dhāt. The Mashīshiyya mentions malakūt and jabarūt; Ḥizb al-Baḥr mentions mulk and malakūt. Both open by Zakariyyā's duʿāʾ (Kāf Hā Yā ʿAyn Ṣād) and the 'seas of oneness'.
Ibn ʿAbbās: Kāf from Kāfī, Hā from Hādī, Yā from Ḥakīm, ʿAyn from ʿAlīm, Ṣād from Ṣādiq — used by al-Shādhilī for protection and guidance.
Hidden so that it is sought through worship, not with the eyes; given to whoever deserves it; for strengthening īmān — used for dunyā it has no benefit.
Linked to Jibrīl and protection — an armour. The 40-minute recording is meant for listening and playing in the house, not for reciting along.
Making rābiṭa with one's shaykh without complicating things.
Listen to it again every few days, weekly, monthly. The purpose of the ṭarīqa is guidance, not miracles.
The compilations are khidma, freely given — reference texts, not substitutes for a teacher. Chahel Kāf / Chahel Qāf belong to the ʿamaliyyāt side, not for laypeople. Seek ijāza from your own shaykh.
The foundation of the ṭarīqa is good manners and love. After adab, the first lesson: goodness is in what Allāh has chosen.
Murīds are advised not to read Ibn ʿArabī's works, though he is among the giants; Rūmī — a Ḥanafī muftī — walked as an ecstatic abdāl, prioritising taste over academic mastery.
Angels with golden pens record the ṣalawāt and add their own; this is why ṣalawāt are said between every two rakʿas of Tarāwīḥ.
Protocols of repulsion are sharp instruments, only against an actual oppressor; whoever turns them against the innocent aims them at himself.
Sohbah of Mawlana Shaykh Mehmet, 16 Muḥarram 1448 — see the archive post.

teachings.t: The secret of Yā Wadūd — five observed breaths
teachings.x: Meditate that Allāh is watching you; with each breath observe in turn: Allāh, the Seal of Prophets ﷺ, the Seal of Saints, the Sulṭān of Saints, then all the saints, prophets and Companions. Kept day and night, it carries the seeker to the Ocean of Oneness. (Book page of Mawlana Shaykh Adnan.)

Bismi-llāhi lladhī lā yaḍurru… ×3, Āyat al-Kursī ×7, Salāmun qawlan min Rabbin Raḥīm ×15, Yā Wadūd ×300 — blown over oneself morning, noon and evening, or over one who is affected. (Book page shared on the channel.)
Mawlana Shaykh Adnan: whoever recites Q 27:30–31 seventy times, Allāh makes the impossible possible and sends angels to fulfil the duʿāʾ.

Shāh Bahāʾuddīn began with Lā ilāha illā-llāh and kept Allāh Allāh after; Imām Rabbānī began with Allāh Allāh and kept Lā ilāha illā-llāh. Jadhb is by grace; sulūk by striving. Shāh Naqshband's silent dhikr is in the heart; the Mujaddidī silent dhikr moves through the laṭāʾif of the chest. (Initial Sulūk Naqshbandīs.)
Mawlana Shaykh Muhammad Adil: a heavy day; take precaution, seek refuge, ask forgiveness and give charity — whoever respects it, it passes lightly.
